The second checks a single batch returns three non-zero vectors of length 384 with correct indices. The function itself returns embedding vectors from the active provider without ever mutating mode; it handles llama.cpp, LM Studio, ONNX server, OpenVINO and local ONNX paths with retries and RuntimeError fallbacks.
